title: Blackbird private-deploy weekly sync — prep & action scratch
content:
Meeting: Blackbird weekly customer sync — prep notes (internal)
Date/Time: Thu 2026-03-12 09:00 PT — confirm with customer (they said mornings PT)
Attendees (internal): Tomoko (owner), Ethan (infra), Priya (SRE lead), Samir (solutions eng), Jules (security SME)
Attendees (customer): Maya (eng lead), Carlos (network), Leanne (sec/compliance) — ask for any others before sending agenda

Goals for this sync (top 3):
- Confirm milestone A (VPC peering + static egress NAT) is green for first test cluster
- Triage block on certificate provisioning (customer KMS/HSM integration) and agree on short-term fallback
- Agree on schedule for performance acceptance run and success criteria

Agenda (20-30m):
1) Quick status (2m) — show red/amber/green on milestones
2) Network & access (6m) — peering, CIDR overlaps, route table, proxy egress, NAT IPs (owner: Ethan)
3) Certs & KMS (6m) — why provisioning failed for staging, next steps (owner: Jules + Maya)
4) Install pipeline & RBAC (4m) — remaining infra-helm PR + rollout plan (owner: Tomoko / PR-4112)
5) Perf acceptance (4m) — define test load, sequences, pass thresholds (owner: Priya)
6) AOB / parking lot (2m)

Pre-meeting prep (internal):
- Ethan: bring network annotation (CIDR map) and updated peering request template (JIRA-INFRA-827) — send to customer 24h before
- Jules: short note on KMS integration options + fallback (use temp signing via Redwood-managed certs) — 1 pager
- Priya: draft perf test plan with target P95 latency and token throughput; include dataset and sample prompt traces
- Tomoko: update infra-helm PR description to include customer variables and documented rollback steps; link PR to JIRA-BD-1423
- Samir: collect customer environment facts: OS, k8s distro & version, airgap constraints, proxy IPs (if any)

Known blockers (current):
- Certificate provisioning failing in customer staging (error: HSM auth timeout). Customer KMS uses vendor X appliance; debug logs pending from Carlos (customer). Impact: cannot complete install end-to-end.
- Route table reflective lag during peering tests — intermittent flaps observed when adding secondary CIDR. Impact: test cluster loses control plane access for ~30s.
- infra-helm values schema mismatch with customer k8s CNI (calico vs aws-cni); some network annotations dropped by admission webhook.

Risks & mitigations:
- If customer HSM remains unreliable, we propose short-term fallback: Redwood-managed TLS certs for control-plane comms (non-prod only) until HSM is stable. Security to sign off. (owner: Jules)
- Performance regressions once KV cache warmed — include warmup phase in perf run and capture cold vs warm metrics (owner: Priya)
- Rollout risk: helm chart change with CRD ordering — keep canary at 1 node, rollback window 30m (owner: Tomoko)

Action items (tracked here — sprint to next sync):
- ACTION-01: Ethan to send updated peering template and requested CIDR ranges to Maya by 2026-03-09 (blocked -> waiting on customer confirmation).
- ACTION-02: Jules to propose fallback cert flow and required risk acknowledgment doc by 2026-03-10 (for legal/sec review).
- ACTION-03: Priya to publish perf acceptance plan + synthetic prompts and schedule 2-hour run window 2026-03-18 (due 2026-03-13).
- ACTION-04: Tomoko to update infra-helm PR-4112 with rollback steps and link to JIRA-BD-1423 by 2026-03-10.
- ACTION-05: Samir to verify k8s webhook logs and propose admissions workaround (patch or annotation) by 2026-03-11.
- ACTION-06: Customer (Maya/Carlos) to share HSM debug logs or permit remote session by 2026-03-09 — escalated if not provided.

Decision points we need this week:
- Approve temporary Redwood-managed certs for staging if HSM not available (need sec sign-off).
- Agree to run perf acceptance with 2-minute warmup and then 10-minute steady window (propose yes/no).

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize low-risk nature of temporary cert fallback, reiterate audit trail and TTL of fallback certs.
- For installs: remind customer to whitelist our egress IPs (doc link in Confluence) — reduces flaky webhook errors.
- Keep communications SLO: respond to customer Qs within 6 business hours for this onboard week.

Parking lot (defer unless requested):
- Long-term: automation for HSM onboarding (gitops + operator) — backlog item, not in scope for this sprint.
- Evaluate VPN vs VPC Peering cost tradeoffs for cross-region setups (hold until baseline infra stable).

Post-meeting follow-up template (send within 24h):
- Short summary of decisions, linked artifacts (peering template, perf plan, PR links), explicit action owners & due dates, next sync time.
- Tag customer on Slack channel and create follow-up JIRA tasks linking to BD-1423 / INFRA-827.

Quick checklist for the call:
- [ ] Screen-share peering map
- [ ] Confirm HSM debug status live (Carlos/Maya)
- [ ] Show PR diff and rollback steps
- [ ] Confirm perf run window and participants

Misc quick refs:
- Confluence runbook above — section 'temporary-cert-fallback' has the checklist to copy into notes
- Perf test harness: internal link to runner job: infra/perf/blackbird-runner (ask Priya for link during call)

Tone notes: keep it pragmatic, low-friction. Avoid introducing scope creep — if customer asks for longer-term automation, capture in backlog ticket but don't add to immediate milestones.

End of prep scratch. Will update this doc after sync with minutes and updated action states.

---
Internal revision history (notes to self):
- 2026-03-04 initial draft prep (Tomoko)
- 2026-03-08 added PR/helm action and updated owners after infra triage
- 2026-03-11 tightened dates and added perf run schedule (Priya input)
